g.text: A natural time-reference error: original response 300 years ago vs source 300 years BC
A: all 1,024 layer/head means, descriptive without confidence intervals. B: 300/years/ago use different original prefixes; ago and BC share q424.
Profiles overlap and are not a partition. Post 300 = pre years; post years = pre ago. Teacher-forced posttoken change does not establish self-reinforcement.
Probabilities are observer next-token probabilities, not confidence in the truth of a complete fact. No token was replaced and no new answer was generated.
One exposed observer example; attention is not semantic correctness or causal necessity.
FP32 producer identity passed; strict FP64 reference check remains inconclusive.
